--- Page 1 (Beckerman_109a) --- My dear son Jack! Today is Sunday and I feel to write to you a few words. I was worried about not hearing from you this past two weeks now I am again happy that you are alright. Abe is going to be transported. I am worrying very much about him. I don't know what to say except hoping and praying to see you and Abe in good health soon back home. Dear John I want to say about your pictures that you sent. You look fine there. I wondering where the smile went to! I would like to have a picture of you I could be able to carry with me. Last week one morning I had a surprise.
